nodes.norm_label: task management (status, priority, deadline, category, duration)

nodes.label: Timetable Templates (Minimal, Colorful, Weekly grid, Student planner, Compact)
nodes.norm_label: timetable templates (minimal, colorful, weekly grid, student planner, compact)

nodes.label: Deadline Classification
nodes.rationale: Overdue / Due Today / Due Tomorrow / Upcoming / Completed; completed tasks stay completed after deadline passes.

nodes.label: Task Progress Calculation
nodes.rationale: completed/total x 100; weekly aggregates without double counting tasks.

nodes.label: Dashboard Information Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Answers: what do I need to do today, what is next, how much have I completed.

nodes.label: Frontend Stack (React, TypeScript, Vite, React Router)
nodes.norm_label: frontend stack (react, typescript, vite, react router)

nodes.label: React Compiler (not enabled)
nodes.rationale: Disabled due to impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Component -> Hook -> Service -> Backend Pattern
nodes.rationale: Keep backend requests out of presentational components instead of raw fetch in JSX.

nodes.label: Server State vs UI State Separation
nodes.norm_label: server state vs ui state separation
nodes.rationale: Do not place every piece of state into one global store.

nodes.label: tasteskill v2 (design-taste-frontend)
nodes.rationale: Anti-slop art direction distilled from 247 curated gallery sites; for marketing pages, not dashboards or app screens.

nodes.label: House Rules (no eyebrows, gradients, shadows, monospace, thin rules...)
nodes.norm_label: house rules (no eyebrows, gradients, shadows, monospace, thin rules...)
nodes.rationale: Top-scored studied sites used icon cards, pill badges, gradients, shadows and tracked caps far less than weak sites.

nodes.label: Laws of the Craft (type, space, colour, imagery, components)
nodes.norm_label: laws of the craft (type, space, colour, imagery, components)

nodes.label: Motion Layer (signature move, entrances, feedback, moving picture)
nodes.norm_label: motion layer (signature move, entrances, feedback, moving picture)

nodes.label: Smart Scheduling Engine
nodes.rationale: Future feature; suggests time slots for user review and must not silently modify the timetable.

nodes.label: Future Features (Analytics, Recurring Tasks, Notifications, Export)
nodes.norm_label: future features (analytics, recurring tasks, notifications, export)

nodes.label: The AI Recommends; The User Decides
nodes.norm_label: the ai recommends; the user decides
nodes.rationale: Keep MVP simple while allowing future AI features without rewriting; users retain control of final schedule and tasks.

nodes.label: AI Schedule Scanner
nodes.rationale: AI results must not be saved without user confirmation. Per project memory, the scanner was built then fully removed (2026-10-11).

nodes.label: AI/OCR Upload-to-Schedule Flow
nodes.rationale: Credentials stay server-side; AI returns structured JSON validated by backend before a user review step.

nodes.label: Scan Review State Machine
nodes.rationale: UPLOADED -> PROCESSING -> REVIEW_REQUIRED -> USER_CONFIRMED -> SAVED, with FAILED -> RETRY/MANUAL ENTRY; never auto-save uncertain AI results.

nodes.label: Security: Auth, Ownership Authorization, No Exposed Secrets
nodes.norm_label: security: auth, ownership authorization, no exposed secrets
nodes.rationale: Every operation verifies the user owns the resource; AI_PRIVATE_KEY, DATABASE_ADMIN_KEY, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY never in frontend.

nodes.label: Scan -> Review -> Customize -> Plan -> Track -> Improve Workflow
nodes.norm_label: scan -> review -> customize -> plan -> track -> improve workflow

nodes.label: TimeSync PRD
nodes.rationale: Product later renamed Horario; PRD still uses the TimeSync name.

nodes.label: hero.png (Isometric Layered Platform Illustration)
nodes.rationale: Hero art: two stacked isometric rounded-square slabs, a white outlined top slab floating above a base slab with a glowing purple/violet gradient edge, joined by dashed guide lines. Minimal line-art style on a white background with an electric purple accent; it suggests layering or a platform/stack. It matches the default hero asset that ships with the Vite + React starter template, so it is likely leftover scaffold art and not Horario-specific branding.

nodes.label: Reusable UI Components (Button, Modal, Card, ProgressBar...)
nodes.norm_label: reusable ui components (button, modal, card, progressbar...)

nodes.label: Mobile-First Responsive Design
nodes.rationale: Avoid designing desktop first and shrinking; mobile bottom nav, desktop sidebar.

nodes.label: Favicon (Vite Lightning Bolt Logo)
nodes.rationale: 48x46 SVG of a purple (#863bff) lightning-bolt shape with masked, blurred ellipse glows in violet (#7e14ff), lavender (#ede6ff) and cyan (#47bfff) using display-p3 colors; this is the default Vite scaffold favicon, not yet replaced with Horario branding.
